components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ebony with pearl text and an inset fret-edge bevel; the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:0 16px; font:600 0.9rem/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms, color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7A3E12; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--ebony, #17140F); color:var(--pearl, #F2EEE6); border-color:var(--ebony, #17140F); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #17140F, inset 0 0 0 3px #4B4237; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#2E2820; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper with an ink border; secondary actions on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:40px; padding:0 16px; font:600 0.9rem/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background:var(--paper, #FFFFFF); color:var(--ink, #1D1813); border:1px solid var(--ink, #1D1813); border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms; } .ds-btn2:hover { background:#F1ECE2; } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7A3E12; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Lacquer Button
components.description: Near-black with a brass-tone edge; only on sunburst chrome.
components.css: .ds-lacq { padding:22px 24px; background:#24160B radial-gradient(ellipse 58% 260% at 50% 125%, #E8A845 0%, #D8902B 16%, #B8661C 34%, #7A3E12 52%, #4A2A12 70%, #2E1B0C 86%, #24160B 100%); } .ds-btn-lacquer { min-height:40px; padding:0 16px; font:600 0.9rem/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background:#1A110A; color:#F7EFDD; border:1px solid #A8916A; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-lacquer:hover { background:#33210F; border-color:#EDE0BF; } .ds-btn-lacquer:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F7EFDD; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Paper field with control-edge border; ink border on hover.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:40px; padding:8px 12px; font:0.93rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color:var(--ink, #1D1813); background:var(--paper, #FFFFFF); border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #8F8578); border-radius:6px; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--ink, #1D1813); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7A3E12; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#6E655B; }

components.name: Sheet Index Tabs
components.description: Numbered folder tabs for the result views; tobacco top edge on the active sheet.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:2px; border-bottom:1px solid #1D1813; padding:4px 4px 0; } .ds-tab { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px 9px; margin-bottom:-1px; font:700 1.08rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display', Bahnschrift, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.02em; color:#5A5048; background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-bottom:0; border-radius:6px 6px 0 0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color:#1D1813; background:#EFEAE0; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7A3E12; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-no { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:20px; height:20px; font:600 0.75rem/1 Consolas, monospace; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:3px; } .ds-on { color:#1D1813; background:#FFFFFF; border-color:#1D1813; } .ds-on::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:-1px; right:-1px; top:-1px; height:3px; background:#7A3E12; border-radius:6px 6px 0 0; } .ds-on .ds-no { background:#17140F; color:#F2EEE6; border-color:#17140F; }

components.name: Bound Panel
components.description: Every working panel: ivoroid binding with black/ivoroid/black purfling.
components.html:
1Choose your sheet music

Drop a PDF, scan, photo, MusicXML or ABC file.
components.css: .ds-bound { background:#FAF8F3; color:#1D1813; padding:26px 28px 28px; border:5px solid #EDE0BF; border-radius:12px; outline:1px solid #2A1F14; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #17140F, inset 0 0 0 2px #FBF8F0, inset 0 0 0 3px #17140F; font:15px/1.5 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-ptitle { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin:0 0 20px; font:800 1.9rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display', Bahnschrift, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.005em; } .ds-step { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:4px; background:#17140F; color:#F2EEE6; font:700 1.05rem/1 Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Paper metadata chip; ink border when confirmed.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font:0.78rem/1.3 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding:3px 8px; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #BDB5A8; border-radius:4px; color:#1D1813; } .ds-ok { border-color:#1D1813; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Provenance stamps on each staff system; never disappear.
components.html: Confirmed Repaired Check
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px 2px; font:800 0.8rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display', Bahnschrift, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#1D1813; border:1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius:3px; transform:rotate(-2deg); } .ds-conf { color:#7A3E12; } .ds-rep { border-style:double; border-width:3px; } .ds-chk { color:#B3261E; background:#FBEDEA; }

components.name: Progress Ticks
components.description: Job band fret ticks that stamp in pearl, one per staff system.
components.html: Staff systems
components.css: .ds-board { display:grid; grid-template-columns:9.5rem 1fr; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:18px 22px; background:#17140F; } .ds-lbl { font:700 0.95rem/1.1 'Big Shoulders Display', Bahnschrift, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#B5AC9F; } .ds-ticks { display:flex; gap:5px; } .ds-t { width:12px; height:24px; border:1px solid #77726A; border-radius:2px; } .ds-t-on { background:#F2EEE6; border-color:#F2EEE6; animation:ds-stamp 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-stamp { from { transform:scale(1.9) rotate(-8deg); opacity:0; } to { transform:none; opacity:1; } }

components.description: Plain-text tab on ebony; the lit note inverts to pearl.
components.css: .ds-tabtext { margin:0; font:0.9rem/1.5 Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; color:#F2EEE6; background:#17140F; border-radius:4px; padding:16px 18px; white-space:pre; } .ds-lit { background:#F2EEE6; color:#17140F; border-radius:2px; }

narrative.overview:
The app wears the instrument: a Loar-era F-5 mandolin. Sunburst lacquer carries the chrome (the masthead band, the job band head, the settings dialog head). Ivoroid binding with black/ivoroid/black purfling edges every working panel, and the masthead's foot carries the same binding strip. The tab lives on an ebony fingerboard with nickel frets and pearl dots; the score reads on clean white paper. Everything else is a quiet spruce-grey ground that lets both ivoroid and white sheets read.

Density is a desk tool's density: one centred column (1180px), bound panels stacked in the order the job happens, hairline structure inside them. Lettering is condensed and heavy (Big Shoulders Display); running text is the system UI face; every number a player reads (tab, fret counts, readouts, file sizes) is Consolas with tabular figures. Motion has one authored moment: progress ticks stamp in, one per staff system. Everything else is instant or a 120ms colour change.

The world rejects the dark-glass AI dashboard and the plain white card stack.
keyCharacteristics: Sunburst lacquer chrome built from one seven-stop burst sequence.
Ivoroid binding with black/ivoroid/black purfling on every bound surface.
Ebony fingerboard for the tab: nickel frets, pearl dots, amber hand window.
Condensed heavy display lettering, system body, monospace numerals.
Inspector red marks only what the player must check.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber as a flat ink appears only as the hand window on the fingerboard rail. The lacquer's hot centre shares the hex but lives only inside the burst gradient; it never becomes a button, badge, or highlight.

rules.name: The Inspector Only Rule
rules.body: Red appears only where the player must check something. A surface that is not a warning or error carries no red.

rules.name: The Paper Is White Rule
rules.body: Notation renders black on pure white (paper). Never tint, darken, or texture the score sheet.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Consolas Rule
rules.body: Any figure a player compares or plays (frets, counts, sizes, readouts, tab) sets in the monospace face with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Display Never Runs Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders sets headings, labels, and stamps only; paragraphs and buttons use the body face (the full-width Convert button is the one display-set button).

rules.name: The Binding Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation with binding or a hairline, never a drop shadow. Floating, transient elements (the toast) are the only exception.

dos: Do build every lacquer surface from the seven burst tokens; prefer the shared lacquer gradient (ellipse 58% 260% at 50% 125%).
Do edge every working panel with the binding: 5px ivoroid, 1px dark outer edge, black/ivoroid/black inset purfling, 12px radius.
Do put tab and fret numbers on ebony in pearl Consolas, and score notation on pure white.
Do set labels in uppercase Big Shoulders 700 with 0.04-0.06em tracking.
Do switch the focus colour by material: tobacco on light, cream on lacquer, pearl on ebony.
Do keep motion to the tick stamp and short 120-140ms state changes, and drop all of it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use amber as a flat ink anywhere but the fingerboard hand window.
Don't use inspector red for anything but what the player must check.
Don't add drop shadows to panels or buttons; separation comes from binding and hairlines.
Don't tint, darken, or texture the score sheet.
Don't set body paragraphs or ordinary buttons in the display face.
Don't load fonts from a CDN; the display face is self-hosted so the app works offline.
